title: Better than the last but still a ways to go
text:
Collector Corp subscriber before Amazon took over and have purchased every box intro'd. Was extremely disappointed with the first Amazon Funko Box as were many. Just a total letdown of cheap, not even a carnival would give these items away, products. The Venom Box arrived today. Pluses included the POP Figure and the T-Shirt. Shirt was similar in tone to previous Funko Shirts. Room for improvement are the filler items, Decal, plastic Venom Choking Hazard toy and the Stress Ball. Really really really miss the "collectible" aspect of the original series including the pins and to a lesser extend the patches. That's what made the box fun for us. Will Try one more Amazon Funko Box and if no improvement, turn off the subscription.

UPDATE 12/5/18-REceived the ten year anniversary box today. That's it. Done. Canceling the subscription. What started as a look forward/get excited bi-monthly event, has changed to severe (first-world problem) disappointment. Don't waste your money, folks.
label: negative
